metadata.description: A local-first, peer-to-peer issue tracker built on iroh + Loro CRDTs.

plugins.name: lait
plugins.description: A local-first, peer-to-peer issue tracker. Exposes the full issue surface over MCP — create/edit/move/assign/label/comment, boards, lists, activity, and versioned Specs, Baselines and Packets — plus membership and transport. Requires the `lait` binary on PATH.
